subject: Co-Engineering Pilot: ZephyrOps OpsSDK + Redwood tracing hooks
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@zephyrops.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@zephyrops.com
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot proposal — ZephyrOps OpsSDK + Redwood

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the intro at the partner summit. ZephyrOps builds an orchestration layer used by several ISVs to manage model deployments and we'd like to explore a co-engineering pilot to embed your tracing & telemetry hooks into our OpsSDK. Our goals are:

- Demonstrate end-to-end traceability (request -> model -> token usage) for mutual customers
- Validate a lightweight LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter in our SDK so customers can swap Redwood as a runtime
- Produce a short Tech Note and sample app we can publish together

Attached is a draft SOW and a short checklist describing the ideal pilot scope. High-level ask: 6-week pilot, one shared sandbox account, two engineer sprints from each side.

Can we set a quick call this week to align scope and resources? Diego (copied) will be our technical lead.

Best,
Amy Chen
Head of Partnerships
ZephyrOps
[Attachment: zephyr-sow-v1.pdf (PDF)]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@zephyrops.com>
Cc: Diego Navarro <diego.navarro@zephyrops.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal — ZephyrOps OpsSDK + Redwood

Hi Amy — great to meet you at the summit and thanks for the SOW. 

We like the proposed scope. Quick notes before a call:

- Technical: Redwood can provide a LangChain adapter + a LlamaIndex connector; we also have a tracing shim that emits structured spans and token-level metrics. Expect a small SDK shim (2-3 files) and an example app.
- Security/compliance: for a shared sandbox we'll need an NDA + a short data handling agreement; our security team will ask for SOC 2 evidence and the network egress plan.
- Timeline: 6 weeks is reasonable if both sides commit two engineers and a PM owner.

I pulled in Vanessa and Marissa to align on partner ops and comms. Can you do Thursday 10am PT for a scope alignment call? If yes we'll send a calendar invite and a small prep doc.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal — ZephyrOps OpsSDK + Redwood

Looping in Karthik for instrumentation/tracing specifics and Marissa for partner collateral. A few operational asks before we lock dates:

- Can ZephyrOps confirm whether the sandbox will be in AWS us-west-2 or a customer-managed VPC? Routing for our trace ingest depends on that.
- Budget: do they expect credit-only pilot or a paid POC? We should confirm up-front to avoid surprises.
- Attachments: I couldn't open the SOW in Gmail preview — Soojin, can we ask them to upload the doc to the shared Drive link so we can comment?

Karthik, high-level technical questions for the call:
1) Does Redwood's tracing shim support open-telemetry span export to a 3rd-party collector?
2) Can we provide a prebuilt LangChain adapter with async streaming and token-attribution hooks?

Thanks — I can join the Thursday call.

— Vanessa
Director, Partner Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@zephyrops.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal — ZephyrOps OpsSDK + Redwood

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the questions — excited to move forward. Quick answers before Thursday:  

- Sandbox: we'll provision an isolated AWS us-west-2 account (no customer VPC) and open the necessary egress to Redwood's ingest endpoints.
- Budget: ZephyrOps will cover cloud costs for the sandbox; for engineering time we propose a credit arrangement (we provide $15k in Redwood credits and cover our engineers). If that works we'll document it in the SOW.
- SOW/doc: attached a Drive link with the editable SOW and an ops checklist. Also attached a short example trace payload we captured from an internal test (redacted).

Tech notes for Karthik: our OpsSDK has a plugin system (Python + Node) — we can accept a LangChain-style adapter as a plugin and will run your tracing shim as a sidecar exporter if needed. We'll ask for an example trace hook and a stub LangChain adapter during the pilot kickoff so our engineers can integrate in sprint 1.

Drive link: https://redwood.app/drive/ZephyrOps-Pilot-Docs
Attachments: opsdk-integration-checklist.xlsx

See you Thursday 10am PT.

Best,
Amy
Head of Partnerships
ZephyrOps
